Usage: rhythm-sightread cache prune [--older <d>]

prune removes the archive indexes saved more than --older ago and then every
cached blob no remaining index names. Reviews of those versions download them
again. The signal data and metadata caches are left alone.

Flags:
  --older <duration>   remove archives cached longer ago than this duration
                       (default 30d)

Examples:
  rhythm-sightread cache prune
  rhythm-sightread cache prune --older 7d
